title: The Bill for an Empty Flat
transcript:
When I came back from a three week trip, I found an electricity bill that was much higher than usual. My first thought was that I had left the heater running. I checked every room, but the switches were off and the flat was cold. I was about to pay because the date on the bill was approaching, when my neighbour suggested reading the small box beside the total.

The box said the amount was based on an estimate rather than a recent meter reading. I had moved into the flat only two months earlier, and the estimate appeared to reflect the previous tenant's use. That tenant had worked from home and used several pieces of electrical equipment during the day.

I called the supplier with the current reading. The adviser asked me to photograph the meter number as well as the figures on its screen, so the company could check that the reading came from the right flat. A few days later, a revised bill arrived with a much lower amount.

I now send a reading at the same time each month and keep the confirmation message. I also check whether each bill says estimated or actual before comparing it with earlier ones. The experience did not teach me that every high bill is wrong. It taught me to understand what the figures are based on before deciding whether my habits have really changed.

questions.prompt: What did the speaker first suspect after seeing the bill?
options: The neighbour had used the wrong meter.
A heater had been left switched on.
The supplier had charged for water as well.
The trip had lasted longer than planned.
questions.answer: A heater had been left switched on.
questions.explanation: 说话者看到高额电费时，最先怀疑自己忘记关暖气。

questions.prompt: Why did the estimate seem too high for the speaker?
options: It included the cost of a new meter.
It was based on the neighbour's holiday dates.
It appeared to reflect the previous tenant's electricity use.
It covered three years instead of three weeks.
questions.answer: It appeared to reflect the previous tenant's electricity use.
questions.explanation: 估算似乎沿用了上一位租客的用电情况，而对方白天在家使用多种电器。

questions.prompt: Why did the adviser ask for a photograph of the meter number?
options: To decide whether the meter needed painting.
To send it to the previous tenant.
To advertise the supplier's telephone service.
To confirm that the reading belonged to the correct flat.
questions.answer: To confirm that the reading belonged to the correct flat.
questions.explanation: 电表编号照片可帮助供应商确认读数对应的是正确公寓。

questions.prompt: What does the speaker now check before comparing bills?
options: Whether the figures are estimated or based on actual readings.
Whether the neighbour has paid on time.
Whether the previous tenant is still working at home.
Whether the total is printed in a large box.
questions.answer: Whether the figures are estimated or based on actual readings.
questions.explanation: 说话者现在先确认账单是估算读数还是实际读数，再与过去比较。
